features.description: QScanner 5.1.0 introduces multiple enhancements to improve secret detection accuracy, coverage, and usability. Together, these enhancements help organizations identify genuine secrets more effectively while reducing noise from benign matches.

features.description: QScanner now supportsCycloneDXas a report format using the--report-format cyclonedxcommand. Previously, SARIF was the only industry-standard report format supported by QScanner and was primarily focused on vulnerability reporting. With this enhancement, you can now generate a single industry-standard report containing both software inventory information and associated vulnerabilities.
features.title: CycloneDX Report Format Support

features.title: Issues Addressed

features.description: You can now select individual events on theEvent Reviewtab and create an incident for only those events, so you can raise an incident for a chosen set of file changes without building a search query that isolates exactly those events.
features.title: Create Incident for Individual Events

features.description: You can now filter events and incidents byThis YearorYear to date, so you can report on a full calendar year or on the year so far, such as for an annual audit, without defining a custom date range each time.
features.title: This Year and Year to date Timeframe Options

features.description: The ignore and restore action now accepts up to 100 events. On theEvent Reviewtab, you can select up to 100 events for a single ignore action. On theIgnoredtab, you can select up to 100 events for a single restore action. When you select more than 100 events, FIM disables theActionsbutton and shows a warning when you point to it.
features.title: Event Limit for Ignore and Restore Actions

features.description: With this release, we have introduced an improved user experience across all FIM pages. features.description: We now support patching for non-security updates for the Linux assets. For more information on the supported operating systems, seeNSU Supported Linux Operating Systems.
features.title: Support Patching for Non-Security Updates for Linux Platform

features.description: We introduced an improved user experience across the NPS user interface, with updates to fonts, colors, typography, and buttons that make the interface more intuitive and user-friendly. Enhancements to the user interface and design system improve visual consistency, readability, and usability throughout the application, resulting in a cleaner and more streamlined experience.
features.title: Enhanced User Interface for NPS

features.description: You can now create QFlow workflows just by describing them.Generate with AIoption is now available on the Create Workflow screen along withFrom scratchandUse a template, so instead of building a workflow node by node, you can tell QFlow what you want and generate a workflow. This is available now for AWS and Azure workflows.
features.title: Generate Workflows with AI

features.title: Deploy workflows based on tags

features.description: We have added 13 new QFlow templates across AWS and Azure, bringing the total in the template library from407 to 420. These templates enable one-click remediation of cloud vulnerabilities and misconfigurations, reducing manual effort and improving compliance posture. Each template maps to a Control ID within TotalCloud for precise governance.
features.title: Added support for New AWS and Azure templates

features.description: We have upgraded the Linux Cloud Agent to support Runtime and Static analysis during SwCA scans. In theRuntimeanalysis, SwCA scans application components in production environments, which are detected during the scan execution. In theStaticanalysis, SwCA scans the application components that are under development.
features.title: Runtime and Static Analysis for SwCA Scans

features.description: We updated the Linux Cloud Agent to support uploading client certificate files for database authentication. You can upload the client certificate file in.pfxformat to fetch the vault connection profiles. The client certificate file also needs a passphrase to ensure that only authenticated users can access the request databases.
features.title: Client Certificate Support for Database Authentication
